sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-15 in the Volve field, a production well in the Norwegian North Sea.
No data tools were available when this review was written, so it gives no measured figures for depths, hole sizes, durations, rates, volumes or dates.
Any figures for this wellbore should be taken from the field's daily drilling reports and well summary, and checked against those sources before the review is issued.
The review does not state hole sizes, section depths or new hole drilled per section for this wellbore.
Casing shoe depths and the sequence of casing strings should be confirmed from the well completion records before they are used in the final report.
Total activity time, lost time by category, and the split of time between drilling, tripping, casing and completion operations are not quantified here.
Lost-time events should be reviewed against the activity codes in the daily reports, with the primary and possible tiers kept separate.
Rates of penetration by section and the fluid volumes used on the well are not reported in this review.
Real-time curve statistics were not available and are not assessed.
Before issue, the author should populate the hole section table, the time breakdown and the fluid volumes from the source data.
Each quantitative statement added later should carry its own claim so that it can be checked against the field data.
